summary: This is a Git configuration setting that enables automatic setup of remote tracking branches. When you push a local branch that doesn't have a corresponding remote branch yet, Git will automatically create and configure the remote tracking relationship for you, so future pushes and pulls know where to go.

explanations.2: The 'autoSetupRemote' setting, when set to true, tells Git to automatically set up remote tracking for new branches you push, rather than requiring you to manually specify the upstream branch.
